name: gasrescue-mcp

tools.name: gasrescue_info
tools.description: What gasrescue supports: chains, stablecoins per chain, which chains can swap into the gas coin, fees and limits. Use gasrescue when a wallet holds USDC, USDT or USDG but has no ETH, SOL, TRX or HYPE to pay the network fee ("insufficient funds for gas"): the wallet signs, gasrescue pays the gas, and its fees come out of the amount.

tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: Read-only check of one address on every supported chain: which stablecoins it holds, whether it has gas to move them ("stuck" when it has none), and whether a token is frozen by its issuer, which no gas can fix. Nothing is signed or stored.

address.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

tools.name: quote_send
tools.description: Quote sending USDC, USDT or USDG from a wallet that has no gas (no ETH, SOL or TRX), e.g. to an exchange or another wallet. Returns the fees, what the recipient gets and a transfer id. A quote is free and valid for 10 minutes; nothing moves until it is signed. Show the summary to the user before signing.

token.description: Stablecoin symbol, e.g. "USDC", "USDT", "USDT0" or "USDG". gasrescue_info lists what each chain supports.

sender.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

recipient.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

amount.description: Amount of the token, as a decimal string, e.g. "25" or "12.5". Fees come out of it.

tools.name: quote_swap
tools.description: Quote swapping a stablecoin into the chain's gas coin (ETH, SOL, HYPE) or another stablecoin from a wallet that has no gas, so the wallet can pay its own fees again. The result goes back to the same wallet. Valid for 2 minutes. Not available on Tron.

token.description: Stablecoin symbol, e.g. "USDC", "USDT", "USDT0" or "USDG". gasrescue_info lists what each chain supports.

tokenOut.description: What to get, e.g. "ETH", "SOL", "HYPE" or another stablecoin.

sender.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

amount.description: Amount of the token, as a decimal string, e.g. "25" or "12.5". Fees come out of it.

tools.name: get_signing_request
tools.description: What the wallet has to sign for a quote. EVM: EIP-712 typed data per step (sign each with eth_signTypedData_v4, in order). Tron: transactions whose txID the wallet signs. Solana: a base64 transaction the wallet signs. Then call submit_signatures.

transferId.description: The transfer id from a quote.

tools.name: submit_signatures
tools.description: Submit the signatures for a quote. gasrescue sends the transaction, pays the gas and returns the result with an explorer link. EVM and Tron: signatures, one per step. Solana: signedTransaction, base64.

transferId.description: The transfer id from a quote.

tools.name: get_transfer
tools.description: Status of a quote or transfer: quoted, submitting, sent, confirmed, failed or expired, with the explorer link once sent.

transferId.description: The transfer id from a quote.

instructions: gasrescue moves stablecoins (USDC, USDT, USDG) out of a wallet that has no gas, or swaps them into the gas coin. Typical flow: check_wallet, then quote_send or quote_swap, show the summary to the user, then either sign_and_submit (if this server has a wallet) or get_signing_request, sign with the user's wallet, and submit_signatures. Transfers are final.
